sections.text: Installed half moon cover in moon pool
Installed and m/u HP riser
Built scaffolding in moon pool. Meanwhile serviced TDS, installed cover in wellhead level
Skidded BOP from stump to riser and landed same. Cleaned and inspected seal face
M/u nt2 connector and installed tension cylinder
N/u slick joint and diverter
Alligned diverter and slick joint. M/u slick joint and removed lifting equipment from diverter. Installed elevator. Pressured up diverter system
Filled the well using trip tank. Well not static
Cleaned and cleared drill floor
P/u cutter BHA
Performed pre-job meeting to RIH w/ cutter BHA
Changed master bushing to ps21 slips
RIH from surface to 695m with cutter BHA Average running speed 926 m/hour
M/u TDS and filled pipe. Took parameters 400 l/min 35 bar, 500 l/min 57 bar, 600 l/min 78 bar, 60 RPM 1-4 KNM, 80 RPM 1-5 KNM. Up weight 92t, down weight 88t

Cut 13 3/8in casing at 724. 5m. 400 l/min 35 bar 60 RPM 2-7 KNM. Increased to 500 l/min 57 bar 80 RPM 6-11 KNM. Observed pressure drop from 57bar down to 22 bar and torque drop to free rotation torque. P/u out of cut and observed pressure increased to 57 bar. RIH and observed pressure dropped. Measured cut of 10 cm
Circulated bu at 1000 l/min 13 bar. No gas or h2s detected from gas trap
POOH wet from 728 m to 493 m
Installed mud bucket line
Continued to POOH wet from 493m to 50m. Average pulling speed 460 m/hour
Changed ps21 slips to master bushing
POOH from 50m to surface and l/d cutter BHA
Performed pre-job meeting p/u 13 3/8in EZSV plug
P/u 13 3/8in EZSV plug BHA m/u and installed spring centralizer
RIH w/ 13 3/8in EZSV plug BHA from surface to 164m, restricted to 2 min/stand
Removed master bushing and installed ps21 slips
RIH w/ 13 3/8in EZSV plug BHA from 164 m to 710 m restricted to 2 min/stand
Removed ps21 slips and installed master bushing
M/u TDS and washed from 710 m to 720 m w/ 800 l/min 5 bar
Set EZSV at 715 m bottom plug. Sheared with 24t, tagged with 5t and released stinger with 25 turns
Installed 1. 5m pup and cement assy, connected hose
Performed integrity test against lower and upper FOSV on cement assy
Performed pressure test below EZSV with cement unit. Failed

Closed UPR and lined up to pump down kill line at 200 l/min 30 bar whilst holding and monitoring 5 bar pressure on the cement unit. No pressure increase observed on cement unit. Confirmed hydraulic isolation of annulus cement plug behind 13 3/8in CSG
Opened UPR and lined up to pump wash pill
Pumped 10m3 wash pill at 2500 l/min 20 bar. Lined up to pump cement from cement unit
Balanced cement plug m 614 m mixed and pumped 7,8 m3 of 1,95 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with 6,5 m3 of drill water. TOC 614 m
R/d cement hose and broke off cement assy. L/d same
POOH from 715m to 550 m restricted 2min/ stand
Installed sponge ball. Pumped sponge ball w/ 1800 l/min 10 bar 50 RPM
Broke off TDS. Continued to POOH to 510m
